checks.method: Read-only source review plus independent stdlib Fraction derivations

stale_canonical_anchor.implication: Use unrounded canonical speed at the newer error origin; do not restart the old canonical polynomial or seed reference from an exposed sample.

underflow_legacy.implication: A torque-free zero angular error would be unsound by at least 1/4 rad; new split phase limit does not exclude this legacy-route witness.

findings.finding: The discrepancy inequality lacks the explicit stale-anchor smooth-law recurrence, initialization, and pre-split underflow error transport required for an independent implementation. The inequality alone does not identify which unrounded speed is compared at a newer error origin; alpha_c=0 is explicitly allowed without changing the legacy route.
findings.required_resolution: Define the reference/error origin independently of the canonical anchor, use exact wc(e)=w_anchor+alpha_c*(e-tr), propagate full-vector Eomega and Etheta, initialize at latch from inherited error, and carry actual legacy/canonical anchor rounding without creating neutral anchors.

findings.finding: The blanket requirement side="after" mislabels incoming-segment or phase-domain failures reached by before-side requests.
findings.required_resolution: Restrict after-side diagnostics to staged boundary changes. Retain actual requested side and inherited requested-time/last-valid-prefix fields for incoming segment failures.

findings.finding: Source-order checks and child-evaluation-before-signature-checks permit incompatible outcomes for a wrong-dimension torque operand followed by a failing duration expression. The inherited force helper evaluates and type-checks each operand before proceeding.
findings.required_resolution: Choose and state one exact sequence. The inherited sequence is structural/name checks, torque child/type, duration child/type, axis-name, positive duration. Freeze a dual-defect example.

findings.finding: Assign shadow-origin initialization/update/materialization explicitly to structural stages or an existing bounded stage, including cases with no canonical anchor change. State that empty torque projection headers on every .22 object are counted.
findings.required_resolution: Provide an explicit charge mapping and add the selected stage to cancellation/deadline/operation-cap cases; retain separately charged arithmetic.

findings.finding: Define Ephase as a bound on the unwrapped angular phase/work integral. A shortest quaternion angle by itself cannot bound work over complete turns.
findings.required_resolution: Define canonical/reference unwrapped increments and derive Ephase from the speed-error recurrence and actual phase rounding, retaining sums over reference intervals and separate impulse work.

limitations: The review does not execute a torque runtime or parse new statements with a candidate parser.
The root author began separate amendments during review; this initial review intentionally binds only the preserved initial draft hashes.
Independent corpus completeness, Agent schema semantics and final publication readback are separate reviews.
positive_findings: Source/Agent/GLB/store binding scope and ordinary Angle dimension are explicit.
Ordered completion, source events, force-before-torque aggregation and all-body atomic rollback satisfy the C089 staging obligation.
Axis latch is independent of route; every impulse is checked; completion can trigger the first nonzero canonical alpha.
Exact source clock addition and single-round canonical P/W graph are explicit; no gratuitous sample anchor or phase wrapping.
The requested-only phase limit includes the exact interior vertex and preserves short prefixes.
SharedExecutionBudget cancellation/operation/deadline order matches the inherited source.
The additive EBNF matches the chosen torque statement and retains contextual keywords.
reviewer: C090 Recording Author (independent of root source/grammar author)
scope: Root-authored source/numeric specification and additive grammar against C089 obligations and separately authored recording proof. No Agent/schema/runtime acceptance.
